derivation: History selected from 1990-01-01 inclusive to 2026-06-11 exclusive; outcome scores joined from CC0 tournament records by team pair and date within one day.
fixtures_provenance: Minimal fixture facts reconstructed from ESPN group-stage event metadata; no raw API responses, logos, standings, text or images redistributed.
limitations: Current snapshot filtered retrospectively, not an archived pre-tournament data vintage.
Historical match scores include extra time, excluding shootout goals.
Fixture dates use UTC and can differ from local dates.
